content: Tolerance is the homage which the finite mind pays to the inexhaustibility of the Infinite.
author: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
explanation: Dr. Radhakrishnan explains that genuine tolerance is not lazy relativism, but a profound philosophical recognition that absolute reality transcends any single doctrinal formulation.
practicalInsight: Engage with an opposing perspective today with genuine curiosity rather than defensive hostility. Seek the grain of truth it contains.
reflectionPrompt: Where am I mistaking my limited point of view for the exhaustive whole of truth?
